added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed manifest baseline_suite and after_suite log contents: 54 passed / 62 passed, both EXIT=0, no FAILED or ERROR ids; this is the focused gate delta, not a claim about final-source broad importer coverage.

assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The first or second sweep selects an expired/older author, or fails to refresh after r-newest is added; fixed expected run ids do not move with the implementation.
The child cannot read the known 4096 control bytes, or the trace parser misses/counts that read incorrectly; this validates the instrument, not the ledger policy.
Incremental classify_tick returns any field different from separately computed fresh _watch_snapshot results; the JSON boolean is a second report of that independently computed comparison.
The traced child aborts or any child assertion fails, yielding nonzero returncode.
The independently counted on-disk dominant inputs total below 10 MB, the fixture has fewer than five stored pointers, or fresh verdict equivalence fails.
The kernel trace lacks either measurement boundary, preventing an empty measurement from reading as zero.
Restoring the unbounded read_records call or removing SQL activity selection fetches the 11 MB expired rows; recorded base control fails at 11,075,805 bytes.

A strict boundary, earliest-instead-of-latest timestamp, or ignored valid alternate timestamp loses boundary/completed/launched/created plans, while missing filtering adds expired or unknown plans; expected plan identities are selected independently from the fixture.
Index file-identity refresh fails to expose replacement of an expired document with a recent returned plan.
Omitting activity_since from the region key reuses the earlier result for the later bound; failing to filter returns both ids; fixed expected id lists independently anchor whole==early.

The normal/stale/uncached branches omit or alter the bound, or change returned values; expected is anchored by a fixed r-later list, so comparisons cannot move together undetected for the target filter regression.
Moving conflict validation behind activity filtering suppresses LedgerError for conflicting expired copies; pytest.raises then fails.

Timestamp conversion rejects datetime values, treats naive datetime in local time, or returns an incorrect epoch; datetime.fromtimestamp creates an input representation while the numeric epoch expectation independently specifies conversion semantics.
Restoring the prior if-extra-only sort emits r-z before r-a when every per-run document is expired; the fixed literal order anchors the full/bounded comparison.

findings.text: blocking: the accepted live evidence attributes 58% of profile samples to the ledger stack and records process-wide rchar, but supplies no per-path byte census covering at least 90% of station reads as the quantitative done_when requires; CPU sample share cannot establish byte share, so that prerequisite remains unproved.

blocking: the matched importer head arm excludes the final promotion-order source repair at 93fd51108b603435722ae150d30be58cffc64a3e, so its zero-added-failure result does not establish the required importer delta for the reviewed head; obtain a completed matched comparison covering the final source before accepting that gate.

item_verdicts.diff: all seven commits from e7d60f9d562f4c4e848491e044eee375e4467935 to 9c6bd4f40dfdf6da2789adce435c713f359e0a77 were read; the diff changes five granted files, extends the existing ledger index, adds regression assertions and records evidence without changing station classification rules.
item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:112 requires a per-path census covering at least 90% of bytes, a sub-1-MB moved-input fixture, a live 20-MB/min and 5%-CPU window, matched importer arms and lint; the fixture and lint receipts exist, but the live census substitutes sampled stacks for byte attribution and the broad head arm predates the final source repair.
item_verdicts.goal: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3797 now requests recent rows before ledger payload decoding, and the five-run fixture records 53,469 second-tick bytes against 11,075,805 at base, while the live station cost bound remains unmeasured.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md records seven commits and readable baseline_suite/after_suite logs with 54 and 62 passing tests and no failures, and explicitly acknowledges that final-source broad verification and the coordinator-owned live after-window remain outstanding.
item_verdicts.write_paths: resume-1-advice.txt explicitly widens the original prompt.txt:80 scope to reckon/ledger.py, reckon/crew/plan_review.py and docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html, covering all five changed files with the original test and evidence fragment grants.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_station_reads_only_what_changed.py:532 fails when the full-history read is restored, lines 570-643 detect timestamp/filter/cache/refusal regressions, and line 659 fails if expired documents cease to trigger promotion ordering; the syscall guard skips when strace is absent.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_station_reads_only_what_changed.py:532 has a recorded failing base control and passing head receipt, whereas docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/station-tick-reads-only-what-changed.html:31 acknowledges a broad arm that excludes the final source repair and docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:413 cites sampled stacks rather than per-path byte totals.
justifications.fit: reckon/ledger.py:1647 migrates the disposable index through its existing version mechanism and reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3764 delegates timestamp policy to the ledger owner, with no new forbidden source names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_review.py:3797 and reckon/ledger.py:1468 remove the measured full-payload decode for the authoring sweep, but docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:440 leaves the live station cost unproved.
justifications.reuse: searches for activity-window selection, timestamp derivation and syscall counters found reckon/ledger.py:_index_payload, reckon/crew/plan_review.py:_run_moment and reckon/_timestamps.py:parse_utc as the owners extended or reused, while reckon/ledger.py:_run_files_written_since filters file mtime and cannot substitute for record activity.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five paths in the e7d60f9d562f4c4e848491e044eee375e4467935..9c6bd4f40dfdf6da2789adce435c713f359e0a77 diff are all covered by prompt.txt:80 plus the explicit scope grant in resume-1-advice.txt.

limitations: No suite rerun in review; source receipts were read.
Coordinator explicitly owns the live after-window under resume-1-advice.txt; it is pending and no 20 MB/min or 5% CPU success is inferred.
The review worktree HEAD is 2a16ef9f3311283b07ded8e24b2d69b6194364af; all implementation reads used explicit reviewed commit objects, not that checkout head.
